name: barracord
description: Sala privada da Barraca para voz, chat e compartilhamento de tela.
author: Chris

scripts.desktop:tailnet:test: npm run build:tailnet && set BARRACORD_USE_DIST=1&& electron .
scripts.desktop:guest:test: npm run build:tailnet && set BARRACORD_USE_DIST=1&& set BARRACORD_ROLE=guest&& electron .
scripts.desktop:guest:linux:test: npm run build:tailnet && BARRACORD_USE_DIST=1 BARRACORD_ROLE=guest electron .
scripts.desktop:build:guest: npm run audio:build && npm run build:tailnet && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.guest.json --config.directories.output="%TEMP%\barracord-guest-release"
scripts.desktop:build:host: npm run audio:build && npm run build:tailnet && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.host.json --config.directories.output="%TEMP%\barracord-host-release"
